key_points: Morgan Stanley downgraded ADBE, citing cleaner growth and AI monetization elsewhere, causing a short-term dip.
Adobe stock rose ~3% on Wednesday on positive market sentiment and AI‑related news.
New AI fan partnership with the NHL aims to reach 200 million followers worldwide.
Adobe may distribute its software via the upcoming ChatGPT AI app store, expanding reach.
Free cash flow yield is ~11.5% of market value, well above the S&P 500 median of 4.5%, suggesting undervaluation.
